title: pi-subagent configuration
description: Global or project-local configuration for the pi-subagent extension.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema.

agentScope.description: Select user definitions, project definitions, or user definitions followed by project overrides.

syncBundledAgents.description: Retired user-level compatibility key from versions 0.2 and 0.3. It is validated but ignored; template initialization is automatic and bundled definitions are never used at runtime.

maxDepth.description: Absolute delegation depth. A top-level Pi session has depth 0.

enableRunInBackground.description: Enable continuable background children and their model-facing lifecycle controls. Set false for strict foreground-only mode.

defaultBackground.description: Default run mode for the fresh spawn provider when background execution is enabled. Ignored in foreground-only mode.

maxConcurrentBackgroundRuns.description: Maximum number of continuable subagent turns that may execute concurrently within one extension runtime.

backgroundProtocol.description: Background message protocol. legacy starts or follows a turn from send_message; mailbox-v2 durably enqueues until followup_task explicitly starts one turn.

reportDelivery.description: Whether child reports trigger a parent turn or wait for the parent's next turn.

inheritExtensions.description: Load the parent's other Pi extensions in child runtimes. pi-subagent itself is filtered out and explicit agent tool ceilings still apply.

openAIIdentity.description: Inject the pi-codex-minimal-tools identity lifecycle as a named inline extension for OpenAI Responses child models.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum child output inserted into a parent tool result, report, or settlement notice.
